lines.text: In 1898, in Kenya, the men building a railway bridge began to vanish... at night.
Then the attacks began. Two huge lions, both without manes, crept into camp after dark.
They dragged men from their tents and disappeared into the bush.
Then, on December 9th, 1898, Patterson waited on a platform in the dark... and fired.
The next morning, the first lion lay dead. It took eight men to carry it.
